lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to buy a linen loincloth and wear it, and Jeremiah does so.
The LORD tells Jeremiah to hide the loincloth in a crevice of the rocks at Euphrates, and he does.
Many days later Jeremiah digs up the loincloth, and it is ruined and of no use at all.
The LORD says He will ruin the pride of Judah and Jerusalem, because the people did not listen.
The LORD says He will fill the land with drunkenness and show mercy to the kings, priests and prophets.

wrong_details.wrong: He will show mercy to the kings, priests and prophets
wrong_details.true: He will allow no mercy or pity or compassion to keep Him from destroying them
